LeaderboardProfile.title: LeaderboardProfile
LeaderboardProfile.description: Public gamification and leaderboard standing for an authenticated JEE aspirant (contains zero PII).

userId.description: The UID of the authenticated user (must match document ID and request.auth.uid).

displayName.description: Public display name shown on the leaderboard (1-60 chars).

xpPoints.description: Total gamification XP points earned from PYQs, streaks, and mocks.

currentStreak.description: Current consecutive days of practice streak.

bestStreak.description: Highest consecutive days of practice streak achieved.

questionsSolved.description: Total number of PYQ and mock questions attempted.

correctAnswers.description: Total number of questions answered correctly.

testsCompleted.description: Total number of practice and mock tests completed.

highScorePercent.description: Highest percentage score achieved in any test (0-100).

badgesUnlocked.description: List of unlocked badge IDs (bounded up to 30 strings).

visibility.description: Visibility scope for leaderboard query alignment ('public').

createdAt.description: Creation server timestamp (clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Last update server timestamp (clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

TestAttempt.title: TestAttempt
TestAttempt.description: Record of a completed PYQ practice session or AI custom mock test for performance insights.

testTitle.description: Human-readable title of the PYQ paper or AI mock test.

attemptedCount.description: Number of questions attempted by the user.

scoreObtained.description: Net JEE score obtained (+4 for correct, -1 for wrong MCQ).

maxScore.description: Maximum possible score for the test.

xpEarned.description: Gamification XP points awarded for this session.

weakTopics.description: Topics where accuracy was low or questions were missed (max 20).

createdAt.description: Creation server timestamp (clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Last update server timestamp (clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

StudyPlanTask.title: StudyPlanTask
StudyPlanTask.description: A scheduled daily or weekly study/revision task prioritizing weak areas and PYQs.

dayLabel.description: Day or week slot label (e.g., 'Day 1 • Today').

targetPyqCount.description: Number of PYQs to solve in this block.

priorityLevel.description: Priority tag derived from performance insights.

completed.description: Whether the aspirant has completed this task.

createdAt.description: Creation server timestamp (clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Last update server timestamp (clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

BookmarkedQuestion.title: BookmarkedQuestion
BookmarkedQuestion.description: A saved PYQ question with personal revision notes.

questionId.description: Identifier of the bookmarked PYQ question.

personalNote.description: User's personal takeaway or formula reminder.

createdAt.description: Creation server timestamp (clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Last update server timestamp (clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

/leaderboard/{userId}.description: Public gamification leaderboard entries keyed by userId.

/test_attempts/{attemptId}.description: Completed PYQ and AI mock test attempts per user.

/study_tasks/{taskId}.description: Personalized study plan tasks per user.

/bookmarks/{bookmarkId}.description: Bookmarked PYQ questions and notes per user.
